decisions.what: Used CSS keyframe animations for particle float and hero stagger instead of Framer Motion.
decisions.why: The project has no package.json in the working tree to verify a framer-motion dependency, and existing components like ParallaxBackground already use CSS/JS-driven animations. CSS keyframes stay dependency-free and honor prefers-reduced-motion.

decisions.what: Treated 'modify' specs for data/services.ts and components/services/ServiceCard.tsx as create because neither file previously existed.
decisions.why: The target files were absent from the repo, so the specifications had to be materialized as new files. The Service interface was defined inline in data/services.ts to keep types colocated with the data they describe.

decisions.what: Rendered ParticleBackground layer with an inline <style> block containing the counteract-particle-float keyframes.
decisions.why: The existing codebase has no shared global animation utility; inlining keyframes co-locates the animation with its consumer while still respecting will-change, prefers-reduced-motion, and mobile particle-count reduction (50 desktop / 20 mobile).

decisions.what: Alternated ServiceCard image position with index parity (even = left, odd = right).
decisions.why: The spec calls for alternating image position for visual interest across a service list; deriving the layout from an optional index prop keeps the component stateless and predictable while allowing consumers to override via imagePosition.
